slide1.headline: AI Threats Push India's Data Breach Cost Up
slide1.subtitle: A recent report highlights the growing concern of AI-powered cyberattacks

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 03 Aug 2026
India's data breach cost has risen by 11% to $2.79 million
This increase is attributed to the growing use of AI in cyberattacks
The average data breach cost in India is now ₹25.5 crore
This surge in data breach costs is a significant concern for Indian businesses

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The rise in AI-powered cyberattacks poses a significant threat to businesses
Companies must invest in AI-powered security solutions to stay ahead of these threats
The Indian government must also take steps to regulate the use of AI in cyberattacks
Source: BW Marketing World, 03 Aug 2026

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The AI-powered cybersecurity market is expected to grow significantly in the coming years
AI-powered cyberattacks pose a significant threat to businesses
Companies must invest in AI-powered security solutions

posts.caption:
The rise of AI-powered cyberattacks is a growing concern for businesses in India. With the average data breach cost rising to ₹25.5 crore, companies must take steps to protect themselves. 
      Questions to consider: What measures can businesses take to protect themselves from AI-powered cyberattacks? How can the Indian government regulate the use of AI in cyberattacks? 
      #AI #Cybersecurity #India #DataBreach #ArtificialIntelligence

slide1.headline: AI Governance Readiness Remains Critically Low
slide1.subtitle: A recent report highlights the need for better AI governance

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 03 Aug 2026
80% of organizations have experienced security or AI incidents
This is due to a lack of AI governance readiness
The report highlights the need for better AI governance and risk management
Companies must take steps to improve their AI governance and security measures

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The lack of AI governance readiness poses a significant risk to businesses
Companies must invest in AI governance and security solutions to protect themselves
The report's findings are a wake-up call for businesses to take AI governance seriously
Source: Cybersecurity Insiders, 03 Aug 2026

posts.caption:
A recent report has found that 80% of organizations have experienced security or AI incidents due to a lack of AI governance readiness. This highlights the need for better AI governance and risk management. 
      Questions to consider: What steps can companies take to improve their AI governance and security measures? How can businesses balance the benefits of AI with the need for effective governance?
